verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's spec page does publish some concrete numbers (CPU core count and boost clocks, NPU TOPS figure, LPDDR5x bandwidth), but explicitly omits TDP/power envelope, process node, max memory capacity, and doesn't state test conditions/precision for the TOPS figure — confirmed both by the vendor page's own gaps and by community complaints (no TDP data, no benchmarks, only marketing phrasing like 'legendary leap in performance'). Missing for 10: TDP/power figures, process node, max memory capacity, stated test conditions/precision for TOPS, and independent benchmark corroboration.
